key: Your verse is over before it began!
en: Your verse is over before it began!
ja: お前のヴァースは始まる前に終わりだ!

key: You've got a good gig goin' on. Rock on, fam!
en: You've got a good gig goin' on. Rock on, fam!
ja: いいノリじゃん。イケてるぜ、相棒!

key: In order to open the door, you're gonna have to play a little song. My bro on the other side can help you out.
en: In order to open the door, you're gonna have to play a little song. My bro on the other side can help you out.
ja: ドアを開けるには、ちょっとした曲を演奏する必要があるぜ。反対側にいるオレの相棒が手伝ってくれる。

key: If you wanna make it big, you gotta prove you can play! Show me your stuff!
en: If you wanna make it big, you gotta prove you can play! Show me your stuff!
ja: デカくなりたいなら、演奏できるって証明しなきゃな! 見せてくれよ!

key: Not a bad jam, kiddo!
en: Not a bad jam, kiddo!
ja: 悪くないジャムじゃん、坊主!

key: The rock wall on the left side is the key, bro. Just scale it to strum your way to victory!
en: The rock wall on the left side is the key, bro. Just scale it to strum your way to victory!
ja: 左側の岩壁が鍵だぜ、相棒。よじ登って弾きながら勝利をつかめ!

key: I'll play you a song-- it's called Beating You, in the key of E-Z!
en: I'll play you a song-- it's called Beating You, in the key of E-Z!
ja: 一曲聴かせてやるよ――曲名は「お前をブッ倒す」、キーはE-Zだ!

key: Tch, I broke a string...
en: Tch, I broke a string...
ja: チッ、弦が切れちまった……

key: The colored panels here are tuners for the strings on the left. Just push them from side to side to change the note!
en: The colored panels here are tuners for the strings on the left. Just push them from side to side to change the note!
ja: ここのカラーパネルは左側の弦のチューナーだ。左右に押して音を変えろ!

key: Suh, brah!
en: Suh, brah!
ja: よぉ、相棒!

key: If you're looking to fight our boy Hardy, first you gotta fight the chords!
en: If you're looking to fight our boy Hardy, first you gotta fight the chords!
ja: ハーディの相手をしたいなら、まずコードと戦わなきゃな!

key: This wall here's got strings goin' across that'll vibrate as you blow past 'em.
en: This wall here's got strings goin' across that'll vibrate as you blow past 'em.
ja: この壁には弦が張ってあって、お前が通り過ぎると振動するぜ。

key: Just make the music happen and you're in!
en: Just make the music happen and you're in!
ja: 音楽を鳴らせば通してやるよ!

key: Those tuners on the other side can control the notes you play.
en: Those tuners on the other side can control the notes you play.
ja: 反対側のチューナーで演奏する音を操作できる。

key: From left to right, they go low G, A, B, C, D, E, F, high G.
en: From left to right, they go low G, A, B, C, D, E, F, high G.
ja: 左から右へ、低いG、A、B、C、D、E、F、高いGの順だ。

key: Match up the sounds and get 'em in line!
en: Match up the sounds and get 'em in line!
ja: 音を合わせて並べろよ!

key: As for the song you wanna play,
en: As for the song you wanna play,
ja: 演奏したい曲についてだが、

key: It goes a little something like this...
en: It goes a little something like this...
ja: こんな感じの曲だ……

key: You let me know if you wanna hear it again, brah!
en: You let me know if you wanna hear it again, brah!
ja: もう一回聴きたければ言ってくれよな、相棒!

key: Break a leg!
en: Break a leg!
ja: 頑張れよ!

key: You wanna hear that riff again, brah?
en: You wanna hear that riff again, brah?
ja: あのリフ、もう一回聴きたいか、相棒?

key: You got this, brah!
en: You got this, brah!
ja: お前ならできるぜ、相棒!

key: You tellin' me you don't jam with this kinda biz?
en: You tellin' me you don't jam with this kinda biz?
ja: お前、こういうのとノらないタイプって言いたいのか?

key: No sweat, brah, it ain't everbody's bag.
en: No sweat, brah, it ain't everbody's bag.
ja: 気にすんな、相棒、みんなが好きってわけじゃないしな。

key: Hell, even I've had to take a break or two-- one gig we got feedback looped into the monitor so bad I had... Uh...
en: Hell, even I've had to take a break or two-- one gig we got feedback looped into the monitor so bad I had... Uh...
ja: まあ、オレだって何度か休んだことあるぜ――あるライブでモニターにフィードバックがひどく回っちまって……えっと……

key: What's it called? Tin... Tinsel...
en: What's it called? Tin... Tinsel...
ja: なんつったっけ? ティン……ティンセル……

key: Tintivitis... Uh...
en: Tintivitis... Uh...
ja: ティンティビタス……えーと……

key: Tonsillitis! That's it!
en: Tonsillitis! That's it!
ja: へんとう炎だ! それだ!

key: My ears were ringing so bad I had tonsillitis for weeks!
en: My ears were ringing so bad I had tonsillitis for weeks!
ja: 耳がひどく鳴って、何週間もへんとう炎になっちまったんだ!

key: But you know, I still gotta test you, brah; them's the rules!
en: But you know, I still gotta test you, brah; them's the rules!
ja: まあでも、お前を試さないといけないんだ、相棒。それがルールだからな!

key: Tell you what-- throw down with me here and now.
en: Tell you what-- throw down with me here and now.
ja: じゃあこうしよう――今ここでオレと勝負しろ。

key: If you win, I'll open the door for you.
en: If you win, I'll open the door for you.
ja: お前が勝ったら、ドアを開けてやるよ。

key: Let's do this!
en: Let's do this!
ja: さあ、行こうぜ!

key: You sure can battle, brah, that's for sure!
en: You sure can battle, brah, that's for sure!
ja: お前、本当に強いな、相棒、間違いない!

key: Sick moves, brah!
en: Sick moves, brah!
ja: 見事な技だぜ、相棒!

key: Let me patch you in real quick...
en: Let me patch you in real quick...
ja: ちょっとつないでやるよ……

key: There you go, brah! Hardy's waitin' for you!
en: There you go, brah! Hardy's waitin' for you!
ja: よし、行けるぞ、相棒! ハーディがお前を待ってる!

key: Oh, nah?
en: Oh, nah?
ja: あー、だめか?

key: That's the spirit! Keep tryin', brah!
en: That's the spirit! Keep tryin', brah!
ja: その意気だ! 頑張れよ、相棒!

key: You heard that, brah?
en: You heard that, brah?
ja: 聞こえたか、相棒?

key: Hardy's calling you-- go on!
en: Hardy's calling you-- go on!
ja: ハーディがお前を呼んでる――行けよ!

key: Go on, brah!
en: Go on, brah!
ja: 行けよ、相棒!

key: Hardy's waitin' for you!
en: Hardy's waitin' for you!
ja: ハーディがお前を待ってるぞ!

key: Yo, I heard that, brah!
en: Yo, I heard that, brah!
ja: よぉ、聞こえたぜ、相棒!

key: You've got some soul!
en: You've got some soul!
ja: お前にはソウルがあるな!

key: ADRIENN: \PN! How is our favorite Champion doing?
en: ADRIENN: \PN! How is our favorite Champion doing?
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN! わたしたちの自慢のチャンピオンは元気にしてる?

key: So you've reached Hardy, yes?
en: So you've reached Hardy, yes?
ja: ハーディのところまで来たのね?

key: You're nearly there!
en: You're nearly there!
ja: もうすぐよ!

key: Okay, so the first thing you need to know is that like me, Hardy fights in Doubles.
en: Okay, so the first thing you need to know is that like me, Hardy fights in Doubles.
ja: まず知っておくべきことは、わたしと同じで、ハーディはダブルバトルで戦うということね。

key: His main strategy is something like a brute force attempt-- outspeed and punish both opponents at once.
en: His main strategy is something like a brute force attempt-- outspeed and punish both opponents at once.
ja: 彼の主な戦略は力押しに近いわ――スピードで上回って、両方の相手を一気にたたく。

key: His signature move Rock Slide is great at that, on top of a notable Flinch chance.
en: His signature move Rock Slide is great at that, on top of a notable Flinch chance.
ja: 彼の代名詞である「いわなだれ」はそれにうってつけで、ひるみ率も高いの。

key: When fighting in a Rocky Field, flinches can be especially nasty, as being knocked into a rock will add additional chip damage.
en: When fighting in a Rocky Field, flinches can be especially nasty, as being knocked into a rock will add additional chip damage.
ja: ロッキーフィールドでの戦いでは、ひるみは特に厄介よ。岩にたたきつけられると追加のダメージも入るから。

key: For that reason, contrary to what you might expect from a Rock-type Leader, Speed will be critical in this battle.
en: For that reason, contrary to what you might expect from a Rock-type Leader, Speed will be critical in this battle.
ja: だから、岩タイプのリーダーから想像するのとは逆に、この戦いではスピードが重要になるわ。

key: If you don't move fast, you might not move at all, so Pokémon with strong priority moves may be at a particular advantage here.
en: If you don't move fast, you might not move at all, so Pokémon with strong priority moves may be at a particular advantage here.
ja: 素早く動かないと、まったく動けなくなるかもしれないから、先制技の強いポケモンはここで特に有利になるでしょうね。

key: Further, Hardy's Pokémon may use the stones as defensive cover from some attacks, so be careful how you approach.
en: Further, Hardy's Pokémon may use the stones as defensive cover from some attacks, so be careful how you approach.
ja: さらに、ハーディのポケモンは岩を防御の盾として使うこともあるから、近づき方には気をつけて。

key: The field provides him little resistances otherwise though, so if you can find an opening, take it!
en: The field provides him little resistances otherwise though, so if you can find an opening, take it!
ja: それ以外では、フィールドが彼に与える耐性はあまりないから、隙を見つけたらそこを突いて!

key: Whatever the case, I'm sure you'll figure out something.
en: Whatever the case, I'm sure you'll figure out something.
ja: どんな状況でも、あなたならきっと何か見つけ出せると思うわ。

key: You always do, right, Champion?
en: You always do, right, Champion?
ja: いつもそうでしょう、チャンピオン?

key: Good luck! We're all counting on you!
en: Good luck! We're all counting on you!
ja: 頑張って! みんなあなたを頼りにしているわ!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールでは 誰も出ないようだ……

key: Skip Gym puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Gym puzzle on this file?
ja: このデータで　ジムパズルを　スキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Help
en: Help
ja: ヘルプ
